evaluation_name: Sahaay AI Phase 4 - Hyderabad Risk AI Baseline Engineering Evaluation & Label Feasibility Audit

supervised_training_feasibility.rationale: Historical flooding locations dataset (flooding_locations.kml) contains 23 static spatial points with zero time-series flood occurrence or depth labels. Telangana telemetry rainfall contains hourly measurements across 38 stations, but lacks paired ground-truth road inundation outcome labels. Supervised ML trained on static hotspots would cause severe circular target leakage.
supervised_training_feasibility.scientific_safeguard: Delivered explainable, physics-calibrated rules baseline (IMD SOP thresholds + multi-criteria GIS road vulnerability index). No unsupported claims of predictive generalization are made.

coordinate_transformations.coordinate_inversion_safeguard: Verified KML (lon, lat) vs Python (lat, lon) ordering across all 23 hotspots and 277 drain segments.

non_silent_missingness_handling.rule: Missing telemetry observations are never silently imputed as 0 mm.
non_silent_missingness_handling.behavior: Missing 1h observation returns UNKNOWN category and triggers warning; missing rolling windows reduce confidence by 0.08 each.

confidence_degradation_behavior.condition: Kondapochamma Station with 2 missing rolling windows
Stale Telemetry (dist = 50.6 km, data 4.0 hours stale)
Distant & Highly Stale (dist = 80 km, data 8.0 hours stale, missing 2 windows)

label_specifications: Timestamped road water depth telemetry (e.g., ultrasonic or radar stage sensors measuring inundation depth in cm).
Municipal GHMC Disaster Response Force (DRF) waterlogging dispatch logs with georeferenced incident start, peak, and clearance timestamps.
Verified citizen reports with EXIF timestamps, geolocation accuracy <= 15m, and optical confirmation of standing water.
required_observations_for_future_supervi.temporal_alignment: Observations must be paired with preceding 1h, 3h, 6h, 12h, and 24h rolling rainfall accumulations strictly before event onset to eliminate future-data leakage.
required_observations_for_future_supervi.held_out_validation_design: Temporal split reserving 2024 monsoon season + spatial split reserving 5 GHMC administrative circles.
